# Choreo Planer API

> api.choreo-planer.de is the public API host for Choreo Planer, a free online
> tool for planning cheerleading and dance choreography. It exposes a REST API
> and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for managing clubs, teams, seasons,
> members, choreos, hits, lineups and positions, and for exporting countsheets.

The product lives at https://www.choreo-planer.de. This host serves the
machine-readable API surfaces only. Data endpoints require authentication;
the discovery, documentation and capability surfaces below are public.

## API

- [OpenAPI 3.1 specification](https://api.choreo-planer.de/openapi.json): Machine-readable description of every REST endpoint.
- [Interactive API documentation](https://api.choreo-planer.de/api-docs): Swagger UI for browsing and testing endpoints.
- [Generated API reference](https://api.choreo-planer.de/docs/): Per-module reference documentation.
- [Service health](https://api.choreo-planer.de/health): Current status of all backing services.
- [Version](https://api.choreo-planer.de/version): Deployed API version.

## Agent access

- [MCP server](https://api.choreo-planer.de/mcp): Model Context Protocol endpoint (streamable HTTP). The capability handshake (initialize, tools/list, ping) is public; calling tools requires a JWT bearer token.
- [Authentication guide](https://api.choreo-planer.de/auth.md): How to obtain an MCP access token and send it as a bearer token.
- [MCP server card](https://api.choreo-planer.de/mcp/server-card): Identity, transport and supported protocol versions for the MCP server.
- [MCP catalog](https://api.choreo-planer.de/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Discovery document advertising the MCP server card.
- [Protected resource metadata](https://api.choreo-planer.de/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource): RFC 9728 metadata for the MCP endpoint.

## More

- [Website](https://www.choreo-planer.de): The Choreo Planer web application.
- [Agentic Resource Discovery manifest](https://www.choreo-planer.de/.well-known/ard.json): Describes the REST API and the MCP server as agentic resources.
- [Crawler policy](https://api.choreo-planer.de/robots.txt): robots.txt for this API host.
